description: Open browser URLs when requested, inspect sessions, inspect open apps/windows, and run approved desktop actions for any app. Use computer.apps/windows/select_app/select_window focus=false before scoped screenshots or actions. Chromium browser background DOM is only an optional route when a Chromium-family app such as Google Chrome or Vivaldi is explicit; computer-use is not browser-specific.

config.name: browser_computer
config.summary: Approved browser and all-app computer actions. Use computer.context/apps/windows before screenshots/clicks, computer.select_app/select_window with focus=false when targeting an app/window in the background, and computer.type for text input. Chromium browser DOM background entry is only an optional path when a Chromium-family browser such as Chrome or Vivaldi is explicit.
